UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and anonymous link configuration.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

username.description: Display username shown on the user's anonymous link.

profilePicUri.description: Preset avatar key or profile photo URL/URI.

bio.description: Welcome message displayed on the user's public link.

uniqueLinkSlug.description: Unique URL slug for receiving anonymous messages.

linkActive.description: Whether the user's anonymous link is currently accepting messages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PublicLink.title: PublicLink
PublicLink.description: Non-PII public profile card keyed by uniqueLinkSlug for anonymous message senders.

slug.description: Unique URL slug matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the link owner.

profilePicUri.description: Preset avatar key or public photo URL.

linkActive.description: Whether the link accepts new anonymous messages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of link creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last link update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SessionLog.title: SessionLog
SessionLog.description: Recorded authentication session audit entry for the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

osVersion.description: Android OS or Browser version string.

active.description: Whether the session is currently active or revoked.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session started (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AnonymousMessage.title: AnonymousMessage
AnonymousMessage.description: Encrypted anonymous message with 4-day sender identity countdown.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the recipient user.

receivedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the message was received.

unlockAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when sender coordinates unlock.

senderPseudo.description: Optional pseudonym or hint provided by sender.

senderCoordinates.description: Sender contact coordinates revealed after countdown.

tag.description: Category tag of the anonymous message.

read.description: Whether the recipient has read the message.

favorite.description: Whether the recipient marked the message as favorite.

revealedManually.description: Whether the recipient unlocked the countdown early.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of message creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last message update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/publicLinks/{slug}.description: Non-PII public link metadata allowing visitors to resolve recipient profile cards without exposing PII.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: User-scoped anonymous messages with 4-day reveal countdown.
